Glacier mass below sea level of tidewater glaciers at start/end ? of the year

Frontal ablation of tidewater glaciers (mass losses from calving, subaerial frontal melting, sublimation above the waterline and subaqueous frontal melting below the waterline); positive values indicate mass lost like melt
Total mass balance (sum of accumulation, melt, refreezing and frontal ablation); mass gained is positive, mass removed is negative
Mass added to the glacier except for refreezing (e.g., snowfall, avalanches)
Mass removed from the glacier except for frontal ablation (e.g., melt, evaporation); mass loss is negative
Total refreezing within the snowpack or glacier.
Total precipitation over glacierized area as used as input to accumulation calculations (i.e. after possible downscaling of gridded precipitation data)
Mean near-surface (2 m) air temperature over glacierized area as used as input to mass balance calculations (i.e. possibly downscaled from gridded climate data)
